data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [I ordered 2 furniture items on May…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/648742155590d2931b5b50c4)
I ordered 2 furniture items on May 27th. After dealing with their movers, Metropolitan movers, who took a while to fill out the COI correctly, the move was scheduled for today. I just called the movers and was told that they are no longer delivering the coffee table since it didn't pass inspection! Never heard from Lulu & Georgia who should be aware of this.

Also, I still haven't heard anything about when the desk will be delivered. Nothing on their website mentioned it would take weeks for delivery when i purchased the items. 

Also, never heard of a furniture company who doesn't take phone calls and there is NO ONE to speak to on the phone! Had I known this, I never would have purchased from this company.

June 12, 2023

Unprompted review

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jun 13, 2023

Hi Joan,

We thank you for your feedback. We're sorry to hear about your experience with your order but we see an agent has been in constant communication with you and provided updates when possible. We appreciate your patience as we continue to work on your order. If you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to support@luluandgeorgia.com.
